description.narrative:
CIPE is a small NGO that works in rural development in the north of the department of Potosí, managed from its headquarters in Llallagua. Through training in how to use environmentally friendly agricultural techniques CIPE supports farmers in increasing their production and the sustainability of the land they work on through crop diversification They encourage the farmers to spread these methods that involve worm compost and terraces. CIPE also works to contribute to the development of social policies, and to improve the standard of living of the population and support social processes through the implementation of programmes in the following areas: productive, education, health, research and training. The agricultural programme also encourages women to take more autonomous roles.
This specific project focuses on helping communities to adapt to the drier climate through the mapping and identification of new water sources and development of plans for their sustainable use; and by raising awareness in schools of the impacts of Climate Change and the building of a network of ‘Green’ schools to grow trees for reforestation.
